BiblicalUsage: Nodab is an Arab tribe that fought against the tribes east of Jordan in 1 Chronicles 5:19, alongside the Hagarites, Jetur, and Nephish. The Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh made war with them and won, because they cried to God in the battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a single verse of war can teach prayer: the tribes won because they cried to God, and the victory belonged to Him before it belonged to them.
